step1_analysis.description: Generates a reference voltage (VWR_REF) by subtracting a gate-source voltage drop from VDD, controlled by a current mirror. This reference is likely used to limit bitline voltage swing during SRAM write operations to reduce dynamic power.

paper_reference.title: 90% Write Power-Saving SRAM Using Sense-Amplifying Memory Cell

VWR_REF_DC.description: DC voltage level of the write reference output

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 10uA bias current at N0. W/L = 10 for all NMOS. Vgs = Vth + sqrt(2*Id / (unCox * W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(20u / (270u * 10)) = 0.506V. VWR_REF = VDD - Vgs2 = 1.8 - 0.506 = 1.294V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The reference voltage tracks VDD with a Vgs offset. The exact value depends on the applied bias current.

Power_DC.description: Static power consumption of the reference generator

sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is dominated by the bias current and the mirrored current through XM2/XM3.

Line_Regulation.description: Sensitivity of the reference voltage to changes in the supply voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: Since VWR_REF = VDD - Vgs2, and Vgs2 is relatively constant for a fixed bias current, d(VWR_REF)/d(VDD) ≈ 1 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected NMOS XM2 shifts the supply voltage down by a fixed amount, so the output tracks the supply linearly.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC reference voltage, static power consumption, and line regulation of the write reference generator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Write Reference Voltage Generator
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VDD VDD VWR_REF GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VWR_REF N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Ibias VDD N0 10u

.control
op
let vref = v(VWR_REF)
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print vref power

dc VVDD 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vref_1_8 find v(VWR_REF) at=1.8
meas dc vref_1_7 find v(VWR_REF) at=1.7
let line_reg = (vref_1_8 - vref_1_7)/0.1
print line_reg
quit
.endc
